description: Analyze all FlightLog records in the Aerobridge database. You must write a script to parse the 'raw_log' text field of every flight log to extract the 'BATT_END' value (e.g., from 'BATT_END:12'). Identify all flight logs where the ending battery level is STRICTLY LESS THAN 15 (i.e., < 15). Generate a CSV report at '/home/ga/Documents/critical_battery_report.csv' with a header row 'flight_log_id,batt_end_value' listing these critical flights. The Aerobridge server is running at http://localhost:8000.
